dismissals.because: .factory/stories/CWF-2/tasks/T7.json:1 This is Forge's own task-state file, written by forge task start on every task branch; main already carries the same file for every merged CWF-2 part (T1A to T5). Removing it would break Forge's tracking of this part.

findings.body: The branch adds `.factory/stories/CWF-2/tasks/T7.json`, but this part may change only `docs/architecture/deployment.md`. The task-state file is neither the required production check nor an allowed test change. Remove it from the branch.
findings.title: Remove the task-state file outside the allowed scope
